mapper.sql: m.id AS merchant_id,m.status AS merchant_status,m.version AS merchant_version, s.id AS store_id,s.status AS store_status,s.version AS store_version, mb.id AS member_id,mb.status AS member_status,mb.version AS member_version, g.id AS grant_id,g.staff_id AS grant_staff_id,g.status AS grant_status,g.version AS grant_version, ms.store_id AS grant_staff_store_id,ms.merchant_id AS grant_staff_merchant_id

FROM merchant_member mb JOIN merchant_member_store_grant g ON g.member_id=mb.id AND g.status='ENABLED' JOIN merchant m ON m.id=mb.merchant_id JOIN merchant_store s ON s.id=g.store_id AND s.merchant_id=m.id LEFT JOIN merchant_staff ms ON ms.id=g.staff_id WHERE mb.user_id=#{userId} AND mb.status='ENABLED'
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id AS merchant_id,m.merchant_name,m.status AS merchant_status, s.id AS store_id,s.store_name,s.status AS store_status, mb.id AS member_id,mb.status AS member_status,mb.version AS member_version, g.id AS grant_id,g.staff_id AS grant_staff_id,g.status AS grant_status,g.version AS grant_version, ms.store_id AS grant_staff_store_id,ms.merchant_id AS grant_staff_merchant_id
ORDER BY m.id ASC,s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
